summary: Allow the public ask route + guest API through Clerk in src/proxy.ts
description: Clerk middleware lives in src/proxy.ts (Next 16 renamed middleware->proxy). The whole chat UI is gated by (app)/layout.tsx which bounces signed-out users to /sign-in. Add the public ask page path and /api/query/guest to the public (non-protected) matcher so an anonymous visitor reaches them without a redirect. Keep every existing protected route protected — scope the allowlist tightly. Note: /admin stays 404-gated for non-admins.
